blocks.text: My sister announced she was selling the house our mother left me—while I was standing in the kitchen she had helped herself to for years. I thought I had misunderstood her. Then she placed a folder on the table and said, "You'll sign this today." She knew I was still grieving. She also knew something I didn't: a document had appeared in the county records with my name on it. I refused to sign anything. That night, an envelope was slipped under my apartment door. Inside was a copy of a document dated eight months earlier, a photograph of my mother, and a handwritten note from someone I had never met. The note contained only seven words: "Your sister didn't tell you about him." I stared at those words until my hands started shaking. Who was "him"? And why had my mother kept his existence secret—and why was his name connected to the house, exactly?.....
